g.text: Rank by ts_rank over the generated tsvector
Order by cosine distance, best chunk per article
Fusion is by position, not by score: ts_rank and cosine
similarity are unrelated scales, so ranks are the only common
currency. Measured: the query "how do I stop my ferments going
bad" returns 0 lexical and 2 semantic hits, fused to 2 — no
